securityClassification: experimental TTRPG obfuscation/integrity research; not production cryptography

tools.name: binary_cube_compute_subcube_integrity
tools.description: Compute a separate experimental keyed integrity artifact over source bits and subcube recovery context.

tools.name: binary_cube_verify_subcube_integrity
tools.description: Verify recovered bits against a previously created independent subcube integrity artifact.

tools.name: binary_cube_protected_subcube_encode
tools.description: Encode source bits through canonical subcube indexing and create a separate integrity artifact.

tools.name: binary_cube_protected_subcube_decode
tools.description: Strictly or tolerantly decode canonical subcube inputs, then independently verify recovered plaintext integrity. Wrong-but-plausible recovery is rejected when the tag does not match.

tools.name: binary_cube_subcube_integrity_self_test
tools.description: Run deterministic exact-recovery, corrected-recovery, wrong-key, and wrong-plaintext integrity checks.
